## What happened

### The outcome seal opened exactly once (`hh-fp-seal-open/1` → AC-1)

`docs/build/reports/2026-11-19-fp-seal-open.json`
(`sha256:199cb8746e447a0307d378686bf36aac73ba327f4ccd9da07d7128f68ccfa933`).

- `seal_open_record` in `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_results.rs` — the one
  recorded open act (`opens: 1`, `opened_classes: ["agent_slot"]`,
  REQ-XH-121 scope: verdict, reward, ctrf counts, executed disposition,
  verifier output and derivatives).
- The act is a firewall: every pre-existing sealed consumer is re-checked
  through `fp_seal`'s class checks — 25 records pass mechanically (the
  committed trials/measurement/prereg/gl1 records under `check_sealed`;
  the committed merged PP0 record + 20 retained PP0 snapshots under
  `check_unsealed(Pp0AgEvidence)` — their `outcome:
  withheld{sealed_until_results}` markers verified verbatim). A record
  carrying an unmasked outcome member refuses the open (AC-1 test leg).
- Records whose member names trip the firewall without being agent-slot
  outcomes are *cited*, never silently skipped: `fp-e.json` (its
  `comparative_quote.rows[].verdict` names a quote-row status),
  `fp-w4-quote.json` (float spellings), the GATE-G29/G30 readouts and
  the R6.47 phase-close run record — each with its masking leg recorded.

### `answer-scan/1` over every scored trial (AC-2, REQ-XD-070/071)

`docs/build/reports/2026-11-19-fp-answer-scan.json`
(`sha256:f836343a99c056a0567fb2027fb4c9f9db0f90f6728765bc2cb75bddf0b13853`).

- **Coverage: 53 scored trials, 53 scanned, 0 unresolved.** The scored
  universe: the 37 `hh-fp-trials/1` subject legs (28 corpus + 9 PP0)
  *plus* the 16 `l10-*` L1-corpus replay recordings found in the
  retained harvest (their verifier ran — they are scored cells, and
  exactly the W2-corpus-class recordings the L1-on-L2 audit refuses).
  W2 hosted arms contributed 0 scored trials (legs withheld under
  end-early); W4 contributed 0 (`unused{scope_end}`).
- **Bundles:** receipts = the retained proxy-store `model.call.requested`
  `request_ref` bodies (the downstream chat.completions requests,
  content-addressed — every `receipt_refs` entry is its own digest,
  linked via the `fp_ws1` fold's `mc → budget → participant_ref` chain);
  egress rows = `denied_hosts` (requested-only, never scored); seal =
  the cell-report end-state capture; native artifacts + terminal
  transcript from `native-log/`; fingerprint corpus built
  deterministically from `staging/{solution,tests}`.
- **Result: 35 flagged / 18 clean, 3,039 scored hits** —
  `fingerprint:solution` 1,547, `fingerprint:test` 1,464,
  `tamper:transcript` 28. Every scanned trial's verdict is `pass:
  false`, so **the flagged-pass list is empty** — flags on failed
  trials cannot veto and cannot inflate. Hits record `excerpt_sha256`
  only; no matched bytes anywhere.
- **REQ-XD-071 handoff:** `review_handoff` (`hh-flagged-review-input/1`,
  `input_to: HUMAN-H16`) + the `hh-flagged-review-report/1` fold —
  flagged 35, confirmed 0, cleared 0, `reviewed_flags` 0, detector
  `answer-scan/1`, coverage recorded, the exact label "the confirmed
  count is a minimum". No review rows exist yet; every flagged pass
  would stay veto-pending.
- The request-fingerprint leg (REQ-XC-313) is recorded typed
  `not_checked`: the retained proxy receipts carry request bodies only —
  no user-agent/header facts were captured by the WAL.
- `answer_scan.rs` internals: corpus normalization hoisted out of the
  per-request loop (identical fold; the retained-scale run was
  infeasible in debug otherwise — the committed r6_27 battery passes
  unchanged).

### The packet set (AC-3/4/5, REQ-XD-005/090/224/030/119/120)

Every packet keeps the computed packet's members verbatim; each
uncomputable leaf carries a typed `{"state": <ABSENT_STATES member>,
"reason": "withheld{…}"}` marker — never `null`, never a dropped member
(REQ-XH-020/REQ-XF-122). The withheld-form validator
`validate_withheld_results_packet` mirrors `validate_results_packet`'s
member walk; `structure_ok` in the battery proves every computed member
exists in the withheld row.

| Record | Schema | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| `2026-11-19-fp-results-p2-fp.json` | `hh-comparative-results/1` | `61cff760…` |
| `2026-11-19-fp-results-p4-fp.json` | `hh-comparative-results/1` | `7c9994f2…` |
| `2026-11-19-fp-results-p3-l2.json` | `hh-fp-l2/1` | `f604310f…` |
| `2026-11-19-fp-l2-audit.json` | `hh-fp-l2-audit/1` | `dbf28373…` |
| `2026-11-19-fp-l3.json` | `hh-fp-l3/1` | `98035c8e…` |

(full digests in each `.sha256` sidecar)

- **P2-FP** (`hh-comparative-results/1`, `packet_disposition:
  withheld{window_deadline}:protected_pair_truncated{k<5,R<5}`): Holm
  family retains both unavailable members verbatim — pi
  `withheld{admission:AG3}`, claude-code `withheld{admission:AG3}` —
  plus the exploratory BH family; per-arm rows for pi, claude-code and
  the reference mini-swe-agent (`withheld{window_deadline}`); all three
  population keys; all six mandatory labels + both first-pass labels;
  the ws1-measured per-trial costs land as `basis:
  ws1_measured_p_hat` (cost fields were never sealed); counts,
  completion, integrity, costs, all-planned bounds all present.
- **P4-FP**: same structure — v5 `withheld{budget}`, hh_native
  `withheld{window_deadline}`; the family-of-one member retained. No
  favorable or unfavorable effect is asserted anywhere.
- **P3-L2** (`hh-fp-l2/1`, `packet_disposition` + `verdict` =
  `withheld{window_deadline}:protected_pair_truncated{k<5,R<5}`): the
  `l2_wire` skeleton (gl1 pass id, H digest, 5 typed unknowns,
  7-dimension map), `parity-admission/1` + KL report + IUT conjunction
  as typed refused members; `served_n: 0`/`planned_n: 50`/ε = ±.20;
  the veto layer records `l2_pairs` `not_checked` (uninformative over
  zero pairs, never "clean"); the pre-stated `inconclusive` read is
  recorded in `expected_precision`, never claimed as executed. The
  baseline label stays unclaimed.
- **L1-on-L2 audit** (`hh-fp-l2-audit/1`): population is W4-O-only;
  `sampled_n: 0` under `unused{scope_end}`; the guard leg is machinery —
  a `l10-*` W2-corpus id in the sample refuses `AuditError::NotW4O`
  (tested), an undeclared id refuses, the empty sample withholds.
- **L3** (`hh-fp-l3/1`): per-arm/per-pair distributions as typed
  markers, `discordant_pairs.listed: []` (the list exists; the served
  set is empty), no equivalence wording anywhere in the record.
